items.title: Keter Betts interviewed by Monk Rowe, Sarasota, Florida, April 11, 1996
items.q: he had to go to the Army so we got Beryl Booker down there, Beryl Booker, and she was for a while

ctx.x: Does your family enjoy the kind of lifestyle and the kind of music you do?

Who knows? No they’ve been very supportive. I mean the kids have their own type of things, but they’ve come out to a lot of places that I was working at and — oh I was wrong, Tommy Flanagan left in ‘78 because I remember we did the Montreaux in ‘77. But that was one experience. Think of in your lifetime, just in the short amount of time you’re working with Wynton Kelly and of course Wynton had to go to the Army. I’m back tracking back to Dinah when I joined in ‘51, and then in the middle of ‘52, not quite the…
And you’ve been working with Junior Mance recently?
